implementation_scope.canonical_description: Scripture-first Chandra Darśana: Sūrya Siddhānta 12-bhāga modern proxy primary, classical Dvitīyā sāmbhavya secondary, modern visibility score diagnostic (optional legacy date path).

decision_explanation.scripture_primary: Sūrya Siddhānta 12-bhāga modern proxy (≥12° at sunset) + horizon window
decision_explanation.classical: Dvitīyā 6 muhūrtas AND Aparāhṇa sāmbhavya (secondary if no 12-bhāga evening)
decision_explanation.modern: visibility_proxy_score retained as diagnostic; date only with --legacy-modern-proxy-date
